name: sample_sdwan_branch
description: AbhavTech lab — SD-WAN fabric with HQ 3-tier LAN and single Mumbai branch

controllers.description: SD-WAN control plane — hosted in HQ data centre

hq.description: HQ campus — 3-tier LAN behind SD-WAN hub edge

branch-mumbai.description: Mumbai branch office — single collapsed switch behind SD-WAN spoke edge

nodes.label: vManage-01
nodes.description: SD-WAN management plane — single pane of glass for configuration, monitoring, policy

nodes.label: vBond-01
nodes.description: SD-WAN orchestrator — authenticates edges, facilitates NAT traversal, distributes vSmart addresses

nodes.label: vSmart-01
nodes.description: SD-WAN control plane — distributes OMP routes and data policies to all edges

nodes.label: HQ-cEdge-01
nodes.description: HQ hub edge — dual-transport (MPLS + internet), terminates OMP tunnels from all spokes

nodes.label: HQ-Core-SW-01
nodes.description: HQ core switch — Layer 3 routing, uplink to HQ-cEdge-01, downlinks to distribution

nodes.label: HQ-Dist-SW-01
nodes.description: HQ distribution switch — inter-VLAN routing, uplink to core, downlinks to access

nodes.label: HQ-Access-SW-01
nodes.description: HQ access switch — end-device connectivity, PoE for IP phones and APs

nodes.label: Branch-cEdge-01
nodes.description: Mumbai spoke edge — dual-transport, OMP tunnel to HQ-cEdge-01, LAN to Branch-SW-01

nodes.label: Branch-SW-01
nodes.description: Mumbai branch collapsed switch — single switch serving access and distribution, uplink to Branch-cEdge-01
